chunks: And the Shaykh, may Allah the Exalted support him, informed me from Abū al-Qāsim Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad, from Muḥammad ibn Yaʿqūb, from ʿAlī ibn Ibrāhīm, from his father, from Ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from some of his companions, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
"The shroud is not to be fumigated with incense."

key_terms.الْكَفَنُ: the burial shroud of the deceased
key_terms.قَالَ: he said; the transmission into the matn of the hadith
key_terms.يُجَمَّرُ: is fumigated or perfumed with burning incense

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to fumigate the kafan of the deceased with incense?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling regarding funerary preparation: the kafan of the deceased should not be fumigated with incense. It appears in the context of rulings related to the dying and the treatment of the deceased before burial.
